entities.name: MurE ligase
observations: 497-aa query has 43.8–45.9% identity over 92.4–97.8% coverage to reviewed bacterial MurE proteins; predicted UDP-MurNAc-L-Ala-D-Glu:meso-diaminopimelate ligase (EC 6.3.2.13).

Reference annotations indicate cytoplasmic localization, ATP and Mg2+ binding, and roles in peptidoglycan biosynthesis, cell division, and cell-shape regulation; these are homology-based for the query.
Pfam matches: Mur_ligase PF01225, Mur_ligase_M PF08245, and Mur_ligase_C PF02875.

entities.name: Peptidoglycan biosynthesis
observations: Reference MurE homologs participate in bacterial peptidoglycan biosynthesis; the query association is inferred from high-coverage homology.

entities.name: MurE ligase reaction
observations: Adds meso-2,6-diaminopimelate to UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamate using ATP, producing the UDP-MurNAc tripeptide precursor; EC 6.3.2.13, Rhea RHEA:23676.
